go.mod: with a single require block and no indirect entries, the module goes into that block.
-- changes --
[{"name":"golang.org/x/net","ecosystem":"golang","to":"0.38.0","method":"override","file":"go.mod"}]
-- in:go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.24

require (
	github.com/acme/lib v1.2.0
	github.com/acme/zed v0.1.0
)
-- out:go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.24

require (
	github.com/acme/lib v1.2.0
	github.com/acme/zed v0.1.0
	golang.org/x/net v0.38.0 // indirect
)
